job.purpose: Approved continuation of the natural-speed footage style.

input.prompt: Single continuous five-second candid live-action shot. Natural, practical human motion at full speed, normal 24 fps playback, no slow motion, no hovering or delayed reactions. Preserve the reference owner's exact identity, olive shirt, charcoal apron and all object positions except the described action. The owner lowers the grocery bag a short distance onto the trunk floor, releases both hands only once it rests securely, then straightens and reaches up toward the open hatch. Keep the hatch open until the cut. Car stays parked, no phone. Bag contents retain shape, one continuous two-handed movement, normal speed and weight. Paper bag rustle, light street ambience. No dialogue, music, captions, visible generated interface, logos or camera cuts.
